answer: Sybil farms stay cheap when one rack answers every liveness check. An applicant posts a signal cork = blake2b(pubkey||cork_salt)[:11] and escrows 20 POA for 5 epochs. A threshold beacon reveals three tide windows only 12 minutes ahead, each 70 minutes. In every window a distinct unaffiliated notary co-signs a fable strip binding the cork to a fresh remote RTT sample within 80ms of that notary's baseline, fee 0.7 POA. Escrow refunds if all strips land. Peers recompute windows and the bound. A missed window, reused cork, or same-ASN notary slashes 32% to the notary and retires the salt 6 epochs.
